_README: Accounts the auto-poster may @mention. Each key is a brand/event/person NAME the AI can recognize in a photo (lowercase; add common variants as separate keys). Each value is the EXACT, verified Instagram handle including the @. The AI only tags something when it BOTH clearly sees it in the photo AND finds it here — anything else it just lists as a suggestion in the run summary for you to add. Keep these accurate: a wrong tag looks bad. Example format (replace with your real ones): "salomon": "@salomon", "my athlete account": "@esteban...", "costa rica trail series": "@theirhandle".
